title: 3473-toc-left-body-id-collision
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-location: left-body
    toc-title: Contents
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - "nav#TOC a#toc-setup"
          - "nav#TOC a#toc-setup-body"
          - "nav#TOC-body a#toc-setup-body-1"
          - "nav#TOC-body a#toc-setup-body-body"
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['id="toc-setup-body"[\s\S]*id="toc-setup-body"']
---

The heading pair below slugs to `toc-setup` and `toc-setup-body`. A fixed
`-body` suffix on the cloned body TOC would hand `toc-setup` the id
`toc-setup-body`, which the sidebar TOC already holds (#14844).
